name: ASPCA Spay/Neuter - NYC (Same-Day Waitlist + mobile + clinics)
neighborhoods: All 5 boroughs (mobile vans + stationary clinics in designated zips)
notes:
Free/low-cost spay/neuter for cats + dogs across all 5 boroughs. Community-cat package (rabies, tattoo, nail trim, eartip) free for Certified TNR Caretakers via RSS; public via Same-Day Waitlist. Also free trap-bank + transport for registered rescuers. High demand - capacity limited. Verified 2026-08-26. Phone: 877-SPAY-NYC Intake: join the Same-Day Waitlist at  TNR: register via Rescuer Services Scheduler Other channel: Income-qualifying residents pay $0 with proof of assistance

free/low-cost s/n citywide: public via Same-Day Waitlist (clinic.aspca.org); rescuers via RSS (aspcapro.org/scheduler). Physical clinics in South Bronx + LIC Queens; mobile vans in designated zips.
